title: CRLR/64/2017 of Furkan B Vs Tanjeem Ahmad Siddaqui

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Criminal Revision No. 64 of 2017
Furkan B Ö..Revisionist
Versus
Tanjeem Ahmad Siddaki Ö.Respondent
Mr. Aamir Malik, Advocate for the revisionist.
Mr. Shiv Pande, Advocate for respondent.
Dated: 08.09.2017
Honíble V.K. Bist, J.
 Heard.
2. This criminal revision has been preferred by
the revisionist against the judgment and order dated
01.02.2017 passed by the learned Judge, Family
Court, Udham Singh Nagar in Miscellaneous Criminal
Case No. 72 of 2013 ìFurkan B v. Tanjeem Ahmad
Siddakiî under Section 125 of Cr.P.C., whereby the
learned Judge has rejected the application of the
revisionist only on the ground that the opposite party
is ready to pay ` 2,000/- in a case filed by the
revisionist under Domestic Violence Act.
4. The matter was placed before the Mediation
Centre of this Court. In the mediation proceeding, the
parties have arrived at following compromise:
ì1. Both the parties shall withdraw all
pending litigations against each other in any
Court of Law.
2. That the opposite party Sri Tanzeem
Ahmad Siddiqui undertakes to transfer
property located at Ladhora Narainpur,
Pargana Sadar, Tehsil Sadar, Janpad
Rampur entered in Fasali Varsh-1419 to
1424 in Bhag-1 as Khata Khatoni Kramank
Sankhya-00077 in the name of Tanzeem
Ahamad measuring 1395 Ft., and 0.2850
Hq.

2
3. That the revisionist Smt. Furkan B,
W/o Sri Tanzeem Ahmad Siddiqui will go
along with the opposite party i.e. her
husband Sri Tanjeem Ahmad Siddiqui to his
paternal home.
4. That Sri Tanzeem Ahmad Siddiqui will
hand over to Smt. Furkan B all of her
ornaments both from her maternal as well as
the matrimonial home which are in the
possession of the opposite party Sri Tanjeem
Ahmad Siddiqui.
5. That the opposite party i.e. Sri Tanzeem
Ahmad Siddiqui states that he has no
concern with his alleged second marriage
and there subsists no relationship between
him and his alleged second wife.
6. That the opposite party Sri Tanjeem
Ahmad Siddiqui states that he shall take his
wife Smt. Furkan B along with him to his
paternal home and will treat her with
absolute respect and love. He further under
takes that he shall not subject the
revisionist to any kind of violence either
physical or verbal which is an apprehension
in the mind of the revisionist.
7. That the opposite party Sri Tanjeem
Ahmad Siddiqui states that he has not given
any divorce to the revisionist Smt. Furkan B
and that he shall withdraw his case for
divorce which is pending before the Court of
Civil Judge Jr. Div. Rampur.
8. That the opposite party Sri Tanjeem
Ahmad Siddiqui states that he has not made
any demand for dowry in the past nor will he
make any such demand in the future from
the revisionist Smt. Furkan B. or any of her
family members.
9. That the opposite party Sri Tanjeem
ahmad Siddiqui states that he shall not
prohibit the revisionist Smt. Furkan B from
visiting her maternal home (Maika) as well
as talking to her family members over the
telephone.

3
10. That the both the parties under take to
give respect and honor to their respective
families as well as the families of both the
parties.
11. That the parties hereto confirm and
declare that they have voluntarily & out of
their own free will arrived at this settlement/
agreement in the presence of mediator.
12. That the settlement has been read over
& explained to the parties in their own
language in presence of their advocates.
Signature of parties are also identified by
their Advocates.
13. That both the parties are bound
by the terms & conditions of this settlement
agreement.
5. Learned counsel for the parties submitted
that the settlement arrived at by the parties be
recorded. Learned counsel for the revisionist submitted
that the revision be dismissed as not pressed.
6. In view of above stated facts and in view of
the fact that parties are living together, the prayer is
allowed and revision is dismissed as not pressed.
7. All the pending applications also stand
disposed of.
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
 08.09.2017
Navin
